name: Brand and naming projects
description: Day-to-day project management for brand identity, naming, and visual system engagements. From discovery and research through to final delivery, with stakeholders aligned at every step.
bestFor: Studios, agencies, and in-house teams running brand identity or naming projects who need a senior project manager to hold the structure.
included: Discovery and kickoff brief with success criteria agreed in writing.
Schedule with milestones, dependencies, and review points.
Weekly written status note and stakeholder updates.
Scope changes documented, costed, and approved before they begin.
Final delivery, handover, and asset organisation.
